beats.text: This mine is the largest human-made excavation, four kilometers wide.
It is the Bingham Canyon Mine, an open-pit copper mine in Utah.
The pit is three quarters of a mile deep.
The pit covers one thousand nine hundred acres.
It has produced over nineteen million short tons of copper.
The mine has produced more copper than any other mine in history.
It was designated a National Historic Landmark in nineteen sixty-six.
